hints.title: Unit Case
hints.text: If numFriends equals 1, no splitting occurs and the entire word is returned.

hints.title: Maximum Substring Length
hints.text: Splitting into numFriends non-empty segments leaves each segment with maximum length n - numFriends + 1.

hints.title: Prefix Maximization
hints.text: Iterate all start indices taking substrings up to maximum allowed length and choose lexicographical maximum.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Extracts candidate substrings up to max length and compares lexicographically.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all combinations of partition boundaries takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space to store the best substring.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies max allowable segment length n - numFriends + 1 and extracts maximum substring.
